 By Tom Kao November 20, 2026 One of the best things about "Love in Disguise" is watching Yim Si-wan and Seol In-ah get under each other’s skin. He’s Yoon Yi-jun, a cocky heir suspected of murder. She’s Kang Jae-hee, a detective posing as his male secretary to investigate him. The drama has topped its time slot on South Korean cable and general programming channels for 10 straight episodes. With the series heading into its final week, here are five things to know about the actor behind Yi-jun 
 He made his solo music debut 15 years after ZE:A
 Yim got his start in January 2010 with ZE:A, the nine-member K-pop group that also included Park Hyung-sik and Hwang Kwang-hee. Two years later, he made his acting debut in the historical drama Moon Embracing the Sun . It took until December 2025 for him to put out his first solo EP, The Reason . Yim wanted the five tracks to reflect the quieter music he likes listening to while giving him songs he could bring to life onstage. The easygoing pop title track lands somewhere in between.
 An office intern became his breakout TV role
 Photo: tvN
 If you’ve ever felt a step behind at a new job, you’ll probably recognise something familiar in Jang Geu-rae. In 2014’s Misaeng: Incomplete Life , Yim plays an aspiring professional Go player who takes an office internship after his plans fall through. The office has its own rules, and everyone else seems to know them already. It’s satisfying to see the patience he picked up playing Go start to pay off at work. The role earned Yim the 2015 Baeksang Award for Best New Actor in television.

 He’s been dubbed the "living textbook" of idol actors
 Photo: Instagram @yim_siwang
 Yim was still in ZE:A when The Attorney (2013) changed how audiences saw him. Watch his face as his character reunites with his mother after two months in detention. Yim called it his hardest scene and credited Kim Young-ae, who kept acting opposite him off camera, with helping him find the emotion. For Boyhood , he learnt the Chungcheong dialect from older residents and won Best Actor at the 2024 Blue Dragon Series Awards. Performances like these helped earn him the nickname "Living Textbook of Idol-turned-Actor."
 He was Player 333 in Squid Game 
 Yim also starred in one of the biggest K-dramas of all time, playing Lee Myung-gi, or Player 333, in the second and third seasons of Squid Game . He’s a crypto YouTuber whose investment advice ends up costing him and his followers money. He enters the games hoping to clear his debts, only to run into Jun-hee (Jo Yu-ri), the pregnant ex-girlfriend he ghosted. As the competition grows more brutal, Myung-gi becomes increasingly ruthless, showing Yim’s ability to bring a darker, more morally complex character to life.
 Playing a marathon champion got him into running
 Yim started running for a film and ended up racing in his spare time. He took it up while preparing for Road to Boston , in which he plays Suh Yun-bok, the winner of the 1947 Boston Marathon. After filming, he kept it up with musician Sean’s running crew. In 2023, the year the film came out, Yim ran the Chuncheon Marathon’s 10km race in 45 minutes and 21 seconds. Notably, he also donated 10 million won to the Seungil Hope Foundation to help fund a hospital specialising in ALS care.
